events.title: Columbus and the Spanish Crown agree the Capitulations of Santa Fe
events.description: Ferdinand and Isabella agreed terms with Christopher Columbus for a westward voyage, promising him the title of admiral and a tenth of the wealth from any lands he found.
events.html: Ferdinand and Isabella agreed terms with Christopher Columbus for a westward voyage, promising him the title of admiral and a tenth of the wealth from any lands he found.

events.title: Luther is summoned to recant before the Diet of Worms
events.description: Before Emperor Charles V, Martin Luther acknowledged his books but asked for time to answer whether he would retract them. The next day he refused, defying both emperor and Pope.
events.html: Before Emperor Charles V, Martin Luther acknowledged his books but asked for time to answer whether he would retract them. The next day he refused, defying both emperor and Pope.

events.title: Treaty of Shimonoseki ends the First Sino-Japanese War
events.description: China recognised Korean independence, ceded Taiwan and the Pescadores to Japan and paid a large indemnity. Defeat exposed the weakness of the Qing and announced Japan as a regional power.
events.html: China recognised Korean independence, ceded Taiwan and the Pescadores to Japan and paid a large indemnity. Defeat exposed the weakness of the Qing and announced Japan as a regional power.

events.title: Last French troops leave Syria
events.description: The withdrawal of the final French forces completed Syria's independence after a quarter-century of mandate rule. The day is still marked in Syria as Evacuation Day.
events.html: The withdrawal of the final French forces completed Syria's independence after a quarter-century of mandate rule. The day is still marked in Syria as Evacuation Day.

events.title: Cuban exiles land at the Bay of Pigs
events.description: A CIA-trained brigade of some 1,400 Cuban exiles landed in southern Cuba to overthrow Fidel Castro. They were defeated within three days, a grave embarrassment for the new Kennedy administration.
events.html: A CIA-trained brigade of some 1,400 Cuban exiles landed in southern Cuba to overthrow Fidel Castro. They were defeated within three days, a grave embarrassment for the new Kennedy administration.

events.title: Khmer Rouge take Phnom Penh
events.description: Khmer Rouge forces entered the Cambodian capital and immediately drove its population into the countryside. Their rule until 1979 led to the deaths of an estimated 1.5 to 2 million people.
events.html: Khmer Rouge forces entered the Cambodian capital and immediately drove its population into the countryside. Their rule until 1979 led to the deaths of an estimated 1.5 to 2 million people.
